title: Why Howard Buffett committed $1.33 billion to Ukraine and offered $14 million for a $1 million request
summary_full: Warren Buffett’s son Howard Buffett has committed $1.33 billion to Ukraine through his foundation and visited the country 27 times since the war began. His philanthropy includes a striking $14 million contribution to a rehabilitation centre after its team initially sought just $1 million, along with support for food, infrastructure, agriculture and demining efforts.
